Description.Name: DiploCattic Immunity...
Description.Details: It wasn't your imagination after all. An orange tabby is sitting in the middle of the corridor, apparently quite content to be exactly where he shouldn't be. The cat looks up at you with an expression that suggests the two of you have already reached an understanding. Unfortunately, Lion seems to have neglected to inform you how he came aboard the Argo. Before you can decide what to do about it, a passing MechWarrior catches your attention. You stop [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] with a raised hand. "{TGT_MW.Callsign}. A moment." {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks from you to the cat. Then back to you. There is a pause. "Commander..." You point at the orange tabby. "Is that your cat?" The MechWarrior's expression changes immediately. Whatever answer {TGT_MW.Subj} had prepared, it clearly wasn't this one. "Technically, aff." You stare at {TGT_MW.Callsign}. The cat, apparently sensing an opportunity, strolls over and winds himself around {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s legs. "His name is Lion," {TGT_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:say|Default:says}, reaching down to scratch behind the cat's ears. "But everyone calls him Diplocat." You look at the cat. Lion looks back. Diplomatic relations appear to be going well. "And when, exactly, did we acquire a Diplocat?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} shifts uncomfortably. "After I joined the crew, Commander. He sort of... came aboard with me." "Sort of?" "I did not announce it." You glance down at Lion again. The cat is now sitting at {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s feet, looking completely innocent. "So you've been keeping a cat aboard my ship without telling me?" {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:nod|Default:nods}. "Aff, Commander." You fold your arms. {TGT_MW.Callsign} sighs. "I know what you are going to say. Commander... I need to keep him." There is something in {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s voice that makes you pause. This isn't an excuse. It isn't even an argument. {TGT_MW.Callsign} looks down at Lion. "He has been with me through everything since I brought him aboard. He is not just some stray I picked up. He is my cat." Lion meows. You look at the orange tabby. Then at {TGT_MW.Callsign}. Then back at the cat. Apparently, the Diplocat has already made his position very clear.

Description.Name: cat joins
Description.Details: You maintain your sternest expression. Lion stares back at you. He blinks. You blink. Lion slowly rolls onto his back and exposes his belly. You stare at him."That's not going to work." Lion gives you a quiet, almost silent meow. You look away."Absolutely not." Another meow. You look back. Lion is still staring at you. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] watches the exchange in silence, wisely deciding that this particular negotiation is better left to the professionals. Lion gets to his feet, walks over to you, and sits directly on your boot. You look down. The cat looks up. You sigh."Oh, for the love of Kerensky." {TGT_MW.Callsign} finally smiles. "He can stay, quiaff?" You look at Lion again. The Diplocat has already won. "Apparently." Lion purrs. You point at {TGT_MW.Callsign}. "But you're responsible for him. If he gets into the MechBay, eats anything important, or somehow gets into the Argo's life-support systems, we're going to have a conversation." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods. "Understood, Commander." Lion rubs against your boot again. You shake your head. "And get him off my foot." Lion ignores you. Diplomatic relations have concluded successfully. [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_DiploCat], DiploCat]] is now a member of the Argo providing a morale boost to all the crew.

Description.Name: cat joins
Description.Details: You consider {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s explanation. Then you consider Lion. The cat sits beside {TGT_MW.Callsign}, calmly watching you as though this entire discussion is beneath his attention. "You understand that bringing an animal aboard without telling me is not exactly company policy?" {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods. "Aff, Commander." You glance down the corridor. The Argo has been an unusually cheerful place lately. Crew arguments have been less frequent, and even some of the more miserable faces seem to have improved. You look back at Lion. "I suppose I have noticed that morale has been better recently." {TGT_MW.Callsign} smiles."He is good for the crew." You raise an eyebrow. Lion responds by calmly grooming one paw. "Apparently, he is." You sigh. "All right. Lion can stay." {TGT_MW.Callsign} crosses {TGT_MW.Det} arms across {TGT_MW.Det} chest in a relaxed manner. "Thank you, Commander." You hold up a finger. "But this comes with conditions. He's your responsibility. Keep him out of the MechBay, keep him away from anything dangerous, and make sure the crew isn't feeding him half their meals." {TGT_MW.Callsign} nods. "Understood." Lion meows. You look down at him. "And apparently you have something to say about this arrangement too." Lion walks over and rubs against your leg. You shake your head. "Fine. Welcome aboard, Diplocat." Lion purrs. Somehow, you suspect the cat considers the matter settled. [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_DiploCat], DiploCat]] is now a member of the Argo providing a morale boost to all the crew.
